```plato

// A parametric surface with defined partial derivatives. TangentUAt/TangentVAt
// span the tangent plane; NormalAt is their normalized cross product, oriented
// by the right-hand rule
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Differential_geometry_of_surfaces).
interface IDifferentiableSurface
    inherits IParametricSurface
{
    TangentUAt(x: Self, uv: UvCoordinate): Vector3D;
    TangentVAt(x: Self, uv: UvCoordinate): Vector3D;
    NormalAt(x: Self, uv: UvCoordinate): Direction3D;
}
```
